title: Staff Security Detection Engineer
location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
description: P-1466 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world’s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we’re only getting started. The Security Detection team protects Databricks products, cloud infrastructure, endpoints, and employees from modern threats. We work in a detection-as-code model and build our detections on the Databricks platform. We are an AI-native team that uses coding agents and builds agentic workflows to scale detection and triage capabilities. You will be an individual contributor on the Security Detection team at Databricks, reporting to the Sr Manager of Detection Engineering. The Impact You Will Have - Own one or more detection domains end-to-end, including cloud control plane, platform security, or SaaS environments, setting technical direction and ensuring detection quality. - Define and drive the detection roadmap for your area by translating threats, incidents, and business requirements into prioritized work. - Build and operate rule-based and ML-based detections on the Databricks platform using Apache Spark™ and Python, maintaining high standards for code quality, testing, and documentation. - Analyze new log sources and collaborate with product and data engineering teams to improve ingestion pipelines and detection coverage. - Partner with Incident Response to develop threat hunting capabilities, refine alerts, and create effective playbooks. - Identify detection gaps from incidents and post-incident reviews, then drive solutions across teams to close those gaps. - Advance AI-assisted detection engineering by building agent skills, tools, and LLM-assisted workflows that accelerate the path from threat intelligence to production. What We Look For - 8+ years of software engineering experience. - Experience building and operating security detection systems at scale in production environments. - Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and programming languages including Python, Scala, or Java. - Understanding of modern security threats, detection methodologies, and incident response practices. - Ability to analyze complex log data, identify patterns, and translate security requirements into technical solutions. - Experience working with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or GCP and their security models. - Strong technical judgment and ability to drive ambiguous problems to completion with minimal direction. - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across security, engineering, and product teams. - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. In this role, you will be expected to work autonomously and take ownership of large projects. Your work will directly contribute to shaping the long-term success of Databricks' security infrastructure, and you'll be a key driver in the continued evolution of our detection systems.
